title: StatuteRadar Phase 3 extraction development annotations
annotator_note: Single-pass assistant-drafted development labels grounded in the local processed corpus; not yet human-reviewed, independently double-annotated, adjudicated, or a legal opinion.

qualifiers.text: Erasure rights in paragraphs 1 and 2 do not apply to the extent processing is necessary for listed grounds
qualifiers.condition: processing is necessary for one of the listed grounds

obligations.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
obligations.condition: in the absence of a decision pursuant to Article 45(3)
obligations.constraint: only if appropriate safeguards have been provided and enforceable data subject rights and effective legal remedies are available

obligations.action: take into account any link between the purposes for which data were collected and the intended further-processing purposes
obligations.condition: further-purpose processing is not based on consent or qualifying Union or Member State law

obligations.action: erase personal data
obligations.condition: the Data Principal withdraws consent or it is reasonable to assume the specified purpose is no longer served, whichever is earlier
exceptions: retention is necessary for compliance with any law in force

obligations.action: give, manage, review or withdraw consent through a Consent Manager
erase personal data
obligations.condition: the Data Fiduciary is in the specified class and purpose, and the Data Principal neither approaches it nor exercises rights for the specified period
obligations.constraint: time period specified in the Third Schedule
exceptions: retention is necessary for compliance with any law in force

obligations.action: delete the consumer's personal information from its records
obligations.condition: receipt of a verifiable consumer request to delete

obligations.action: notify service providers or contractors to delete the consumer's personal information from their records
obligations.condition: receipt of a verifiable consumer request to delete
exceptions: unless this proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort

obligations.action: notify third parties to delete the consumer's personal information that the business sold or shared
obligations.condition: receipt of a verifiable consumer request to delete
exceptions: unless this proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort

obligations.action: sell or share consumers' personal information
obligations.condition: the business has actual knowledge that the consumer is under 16 years of age
exceptions: affirmative authorization by the consumer aged 13 to under 16, or by the parent or guardian for a consumer under 13

obligations.action: notify the personal data breach to the competent supervisory authority
obligations.constraint: without undue delay and, where feasible, no later than 72 hours after awareness
exceptions: the personal data breach is unlikely to result in a risk to natural persons' rights and freedoms

obligations.action: accompany a late notification with reasons for the delay
obligations.condition: notification is not made within 72 hours

obligations.action: process personal data lawfully, fairly and transparently in relation to the data subject
withdraw consent
obligations.condition: consent is the basis of processing
obligations.constraint: at any time, with ease comparable to giving consent

obligations.action: make a request to the Data Fiduciary for erasure of personal data
erase the Data Principal's personal data
obligations.condition: upon receipt of an erasure request
exceptions: retention is necessary for the specified purpose or compliance with any law in force

obligations.action: protect personal data by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach
obligations.condition: the data is in its possession or under its control, including processing undertaken by it or for it by a Data Processor
obligations.constraint: including, at a minimum, the listed appropriate measures

obligations.action: inform the Data Principal that the personal data will be erased upon completion of the period
obligations.condition: at least forty-eight hours before the erasure period ends
obligations.constraint: at least forty-eight hours before completion
exceptions: unless the Data Principal logs in, contacts the Data Fiduciary for the purpose, or exercises rights

obligations.action: implement reasonable security procedures and practices to protect personal information
obligations.condition: appropriate to the nature of the personal information

obligations.action: direct a business not to sell or share the consumer's personal information
comply with a consumer's direction to the transferor
obligations.condition: the business receives personal information in an asset transfer and the consumer directed the transferor not to sell or share
